messages:
jess: anyone else seeing slow charts after yesterday's telemetry middleware rollout? heatmaps & sparklines lagging, main thread decode spikes :thinking:

aditya: seeing it on canary and prod-ish. repro: open dashboard -> hover heatmap -> UI blocks ~300-600ms

marta: looking at flamegraphs — lots of time in FontFace and Intl.pluralRules during initial paint

phil: curious — telemetry change touched init pipeline, it added `telemetry/augment` import in chart entry?

deploy-bot: canary rollout to 20% completed at 2024-04-05T10:12Z

jess: we didn't touch fonts, but telemetry eager init might be pulling extra locales.

aditya: log snippet:
```
main.thread: parseSync(telemetry) -> loadLocale('en-US') -> registerFont('/fonts/inter-var.woff2')
font decode cost ~120ms x many widgets
```

sam: also saw routing policy tweak yesterday that reweighted EU traffic to canary — EU clients fetch bigger bundles (intl locale chunks) more often -> cache miss spiral

jess: ah — route weights + telemetry eager import = more clients loading intl chunks on first render

marta: quick mitigation ideas:
- set telemetry.eager=false
- lazy-import telemetry inside chart components
- move locale loading to worker

phil: can we also change prefetch hints? current `<link rel=preload>` for fonts might cause main-thread decode contention

aditya: I'll run RUM traces and K/V cache hit rates. If cache hit drops are correlated with reweights, we can revert routing or bump cache TTL for intl chunks.

jess: I'm going to open a rollback canary and flip telemetry.eager flag for experiments. creating ticket now: https://tickets/redwood/INC-4423

marta: if we need hotfix, we can ship patch that lazy-loads `telemetry/augment` and blocks eager locale load

phil: small A/B test: flip routing weight back to 0.2 for EU -> monitor LCP, FCP and chart render p99

aditya: noted. collecting traces now. will post perf gist when ready

jess: thanks — ping me when traces up. if p99 improves after rollback we follow with a proper fix (lazy import + worker locale load)

telemetry-bot: perf-alert: LCP spike detected on dashboard canary 1714999900 -> 1715000200 (p99 +42%) :warning:

jess: got it — rolling canary rollback now :rocket:
